description: SEPA-compliant credit transfer from Germany to France. Demonstrates compliance with SEPA Credit Transfer Rulebook requirements including EUR currency, SHAR charge bearer, IBANs, SEPA service level, and TARGET2 clearing system.
test_coverage: SEPA service level code (SEPA in SvcLvl)
TARGET2 clearing system (European real-time gross settlement)
IBANs for both debtor and creditor (SEPA requirement)
BIC codes from SEPA zone countries (Germany and France)
Address with special characters (Élysées with accents)
business_rules_expected_to_pass: PACS008-AM02: Currency decimal places valid (EUR has 2 decimals)
PACS008-DT01: Settlement date not in past
PACS008-IB01: Valid debtor IBAN with Mod-97
PACS008-IB02: Valid creditor IBAN with Mod-97
PACS008-RF03: UETR is valid UUID format
PACS008-SP02: SEPA payment amount within limits
PACS008-SP03: SEPA zone BICs (DE and FR are EU members)
notes: This message is semantically equivalent to the sepa_credit.mt MT103 test case. It demonstrates full SEPA compliance and can be used for round-trip translation testing. The address uses UTF-8 characters (Élysées) which would be transliterated to ASCII (Elysees) when converting to MT format.
